entries.text: Turn on the glass washer
Turn on the bar lights
Check the bins are in place and lined with bags
Place the bar mat
Set up cutting boards for fruit
Fill the station with ice
Take juices out of the fridge
Place Prosecco in its bucket
Remove all bottle caps
Fill the utensil cup with water for bar spoons and tongs
Place all bar towels in their spot
Check for empty bottles and refill as needed
Check juice bottles in the fridge and refill if necessary
Check the bar and spritz bar fridges and refill as needed
Check the back beer & fruit fridge — refill as needed and discard any fruit or garnish not in condition
Check Negroni and OTR ice — refill if needed
Check bitters, Tabasco, and bar garnishes
Notify the manager of any missing items or low stock
Check cut fruit from the previous day
Discard anything not in perfect condition
Cut fresh fruit as needed
Check the bar fruit basket:
Discard poor-quality fruit and refill as needed
Check freezer ice levels and refill if needed
Check fruit in the back (black) fridge
Discard anything not in good condition
Notify the manager for ordering
Ensure ALWAYS:
Ensure other juices are at least half full
Notify manager if stock is low
Ensure ALWAYS 1 box of Negroni ice
Check olive oil martini pre-batch — if below half, notify manager to prepare more
Ensure all bottles on shelves face forward
Check for any leaks or spills

service.label: During Service
service.title: During Service — Quick Reference
service.sourceNote: It is every bartender’s responsibility to keep the bottles flowing: whenever it is needed, refill the relevant fridges with the missing products.

cards.heading: Fruit
items: Check fruit quality and levels from the previous shift
Discard anything not in perfect condition, refill as needed

cards.heading: Fridges & Stock
items: Check fridges and restock as necessary
Check back fridges and restock: beer, soft drinks, juices, ice — and anything else running low

cards.heading: Ice & Bottles
items: Check ice at the station and in the freezer, refill as needed

entries.text: Wash cutting boards, bar mats, jiggers, and all station bottles
Clean the entire bar surface with cleaning products
Remove all ice from the station and set 3 glasses of vinegar to clean
Refill all fridges with:
Organize all bottles on shelves if needed
Turn off the glass washer
Turn off the lights
